content.short: Holdstation provides a smart contract wallet for futures trading and embraces native Account Abstraction on zkSync Era.
content.description: Holdstation delivers secure, decentralized cryptocurrency management through a user-friendly Web3 wallet and an in-app perpetual DEX on zkSync. It lets users store and manage assets across multiple EVM-compatible networks, including Ethereum. Its Account Abstraction feature simplifies transaction handling and gas payments, making trading more efficient and cost-effective. Users can trade a broad range of assets—cryptocurrencies, forex, and commodities—with high leverage options, while maintaining full control of their funds and enjoying a robust, optimized trading experience.
content.meta: Holdstation provides a user-friendly Web3 Wallet with an in-app perpetual DEX on zkSync. Discover Holdstation and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
